findings.title: Radar Instrument Broken
findings.where: Left side of arena and road screens (radar panel)
findings.problem: Radar display is a solid black disc with no visible sweep line or contact indicators (e.g., rotating line, glowing dots for targets)
findings.why: Players cannot determine if the radar is active or detect enemies, undermining combat awareness and feedback
findings.fix: Add a thin green sweep line rotating around the radar edge and small green dots for detected contacts (e.g., one dot for testing)

findings.title: City Map Icon Contrast
findings.where: Central area of city screenshot (arrow-shaped vehicle icons on cracked map)
findings.problem: Colored arrow icons (green/orange/red) blend with gray cracked background due to low contrast/saturation
findings.why: Players miss navigation cues or mission locations, causing confusion during courier work
findings.fix: Increase icon saturation by 20% and add a 1px white outline to make icons pop against the background

findings.title: Title Screen Tagline Readability
findings.where: Center of title screen, beneath "SMDUEL" logo
findings.problem: Tagline text is small, low-contrast, and blends with the dusty orange background
findings.why: Players fail to absorb the game’s core premise quickly, weakening first impression and marketing
findings.fix: Increase tagline font size by 20% and add a 1px dark outline to text for contrast against the background

findings.title: Constructor Weapon Slot Labels
findings.where: Left panel of constructor screen, under "Weapon 1-10" rows
findings.problem: (empty) text is too small (8-9px) and low-contrast against dark background
findings.why: Players can’t confirm empty weapon slots quickly, causing frustration during vehicle building
findings.fix: Increase (empty) text size to 12px and use bright cyan color (matching weapon icons) for readability

findings.title: Condition Panel Text Size
findings.where: Right panel of arena screen, under "Armour" and "Tyres" sections
findings.problem: Numbers (e.g., "FR: 4/4") are too small (8-9px) and lack contrast against dark background
findings.why: Players miss armor/tyre status during fast-paced arena fights, leading to poor combat decisions
findings.fix: Increase text size to 12px and use bright green (matching the progress bars) for the numbers
